name: sdlc-automation-vscode
description: Turns requirements and Figma screens into an approved PRD, BRD, test cases and Jira stories using GitHub Copilot, with a human review at every step.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: GitHub Copilot is turned off in Restricted Mode, so documents cannot be written until you trust the folder.

sdlcAutomation.model.description: The Copilot model that writes the documents. Empty means Auto: the most capable available model. Easiest to change from the model list in the tool's top bar.

sdlcAutomation.reviewerName.description: Your name as it appears in approvals and the audit log. Defaults to your computer user name.

sdlcAutomation.autoAdvance.description: Start the next step automatically after an approval.
